Name: Saleor
Desc: Saleor headless e-commerce (Django/GraphQL API under uvicorn plus a Celery worker) over PostgreSQL, Valkey and RabbitMQ, driven by cyclical storefront traffic (browsing and checkouts). Ported from Incident Arena. An `ops-toolbox` pod provides an operator shell: psql with the privileged PostgreSQL DSN in $DB_ADMIN_DSN, curl for the GraphQL API at $SALEOR_API_URL, and RabbitMQ management credentials in $RABBITMQ_ADMIN_URL. PostgreSQL, Valkey and RabbitMQ exporters are scraped by Prometheus.
Supported Operations: Deliver order events asynchronously through Celery
